query:
SELECT
            mqa.module_id  AS quiz_id,
            lm.title       AS quiz_title,
            mqa.score,
            mqa.passed,
            mqa.created_at AS attempted_at
        FROM module_quiz_attempts mqa
        JOIN learning_modules lm ON lm.id = mqa.module_id
        WHERE mqa.user_id = $1
        ORDER BY mqa.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 10
